title: Five-bit field-prefix compression with elementary existence and complete coefficient-four certificates

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total five-bit-compressed field-prefix family in proof.md Sections1--2 and family.py. For saved=0,...,5 enumerate primes2<=k<N+saved, m=N+saved-k, r=ceil(m/k), r>=3,k>r+1,and2<=t<r. Use the zero-deficit threshold d=H+E0+1 from disperser.md Section12 and B=t(t+3)/2<=d<m. Actual prefix length p=k-saved consists of k-5 encoded bits for R=Z^(k-4)+prefix and ignored=5-saved ignored bits; Q=1+(Z^4+Z^2)R. Select the minimum(4p+8d-4B-3,k,t,ignored) together with a zero option(4N,0,0,0). Test Q by the exact prime-degree irreducibility criterion; reject invalid prefixes; evaluate the descending-power order-t symmetric payload polynomial with zero padding.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This single total family is in uniform P, hence NP with empty witnesses. Every eligible prime degree k>=5 has an encoded irreducible Q by the supplied elementary trace-root and reciprocal-normalization argument. For every actual integer N, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-L_N, with L_N the selected loss including the zero option4N. If L0 is the complete zero-deficit reference loss, L_N=min(4N,min_(s=0,...,5)(L0(N+s)-4s)), so it never exceeds any retained reference when present. Every sufficiently large integer length has L_N=O(N^(4/5))=o(N). Thus for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon with C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)N for every integer N>=N_epsilon in the full Li-Yang B2 model.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

claims: For every odd prime k>=5, at least one irreducible monic polynomial Q over F2 has the form Q=1+(Z^4+Z^2)R with monic R of degree k-4 and coefficient of Z^(k-5) equal0. The k-5 remaining coefficients give an injective affine decoder; proof.md Section2.1 supplies existence without external irreducible-construction assumptions.

The complete finite certified losses(original,weighted,positive-exact,zero-deficit,new) are(1461,1437,1429,1413,1393) at N=500,(2533,2493,2485,2485,2465) at N=1000,(4513,4449,4433,4417,4397) at N=2000,and(16809,16601,16577,16521,16501) at N=10000. These compare certificates, not actual circuit sizes.

experiments.purpose: Bounded reference searches and six-length compression minima; all4421 encoded polynomials at prime degrees5,7,11,13,17; retained zero-deficit integer maxima/witnesses, matrix ranks, field-prefix tests and valid complete evaluator cases including ignored bits. Universal claims rest on the supplied written proofs.
